item.description: Polon #1021 the Hollow of the House of Udaeus fell (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Polon has drunk from Lethe 3 times and remembers little.

item.description: Polon #1021 the Hollow was broken and is whole again (3×). The House of Udaeus made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Polon has drunk from Lethe 3 times and remembers little.
